witness.branch: Human warning followed by an observed go signal, continued presence or departure.
witness.quote: or the flagman or person stationed at such pedestrian lane has given a signal to go, or has left the locality.
witness.reason: Two-way travel is compatible with an approach to a school pedestrian lane controlled by a stationed person.
required_context: A stationed flagman or other person gives warning of children about to cross or crossing.
Actual school pedestrian lane geometry and nearest side, with a connected ego approach on the two-lane two-way road.
Applicable municipal jurisdiction and unresolved definition applicability.
Establish a stationed person's warning that children are about to cross or crossing, separately from children's actual movement and school-zone designation.
Establish jurisdiction, applicable definitions, lane identity and geometry, nearest side and connected ego approach.
Record human signals, presence and movement, children's movements, vehicle motion and stop distances; do not select a locality boundary.
Retain human signals, presence and movement and all statutory release alternatives; do not select a locality boundary or require release within the observation interval.
Retain vehicle motion, complete cessation and stop distances in feet with the vehicle reference point and measurement method identified but not legally prescribed.
witness.subject_reason: The driver operates a motor vehicle toward the warned lane and is expressly within the operative subject.
